title: 'Why is Philly calling me?' USC's Makai Lemon was on the phone with another team when Eagles swooped in

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 'Why is Philly calling me?' USC's Makai Lemon was on the phone with another team when Eagles swooped in
sources.description: Former USC receiver Makai Lemon was on the phone with the Pittsburgh Steelers when he learned the Philadelphia Eagles had traded up in the NFL draft to pick him a spot earlier.
